title: Extraction of Qualitative Photoluminescence and Series Resistance Images from a Single Electroluminescence Measurement
mechanism: A network trained on simulations decomposes one EL image into a recombination (PL-like) image and a series-resistance image.
adaptation: An Rs-like channel could separate inactive / disconnected areas (resistance or isolation) from dark material and edge_dark (recombination). Needs released weights or a cell simulator to make training pairs; neither found.
min_experiment: Only if weights are public: PF with predicted Rs channel vs PF; CV inactive IoU and material IoU; kill if both < +0.01.
evidence: R: high accuracy on unseen simulations; authors say more work is needed for real images.
